articles.title: Spider-Man Almost Fought a Different X-Men Villain!
articles.summary: Spider-Man's new movie almost had a totally different bad guy: the Shadow King, an X-Men villain. The writers even thought about using him before Marvel said no. Instead, Spider-Man fights Jean Grey!

articles.title: This Artist Types Pictures Instead of Drawing Them
articles.summary: James Cook makes art with a typewriter, not a paintbrush! He typed a tennis court using over one million keystrokes. His artworks sell for thousands of dollars.

articles.title: Great Britain Smashes Ecuador to Reach Davis Cup Finals!
articles.summary: Great Britain beat Ecuador 4-0 in tennis to reach the Davis Cup Finals for the first time since 2023. Henry Patten and Neal Skupski won the doubles to seal the victory.
